formula: Stay_Days ~ Hospital_type + Hospital_region + Hospital_city + Available_Extra_Rooms_in_Hospital + Department + Ward_Type + Ward_Facility + Bed_Grade + Type_of_Admission + Illness_Severity + Patient_Visitors + Age + Admission_Deposit + City_Code_Patient + (1|Hospital) + (1|patientid)
notes: Analytics-Vidhya healthcare hackathon (OpenML COVID-19-Hospitals-Treatment-Plan): predict length-of-stay class (Stay_Days, 11 ordered bins, filed categorical as >10 levels) per admission; Hospital (32) the clustering unit, patients repeat within. No published mixed model; formula is the natural random-intercept over Hospital. case_id ignored. Hand sample #13 (O/low blind re-read): patientid added, crossed with Hospital: patients recur across hospitals (92017 patients, 3.5 admissions each, 75% in more than one hospital); City_Code_Patient added beside Hospital_city, the two measure different locations; a city nested in a region stays in the predictor inventory, redundant contrasts being a fitting issue.

formula: diagnostic ~ smoke + drink + background_father + background_mother + age + pesticide + gender + skin_cancer_history + cancer_history + has_piped_water + has_sewage_system + fitspatrick + region + diameter_1 + diameter_2 + itch + grew + hurt + changed + bleed + elevation + (1|patient_id) + (1|lesion_id)
notes: PAD-UFES-20 skin-lesion dataset (Pacheco et al. 2020): 2298 images, 1373 patients (up to 10 images/lesions per patient); diagnostic (6 lesion types) the documented classification target, patient_id the clustering unit. No mixed model; formula is the natural random-intercept over patient_id. img_id/biopsed ignored. Hand sample #13 (O/low blind re-read): lesion_id added: images repeat within lesions nested in patients (the authors' patient > lesion > image hierarchy, arXiv 2007.00478; 1641 lesions, 1.4 images each); lesion ids are globally unique, so separate patient and lesion terms encode the nesting.

formula: I(readmitted == "<30") ~ discharge_home + race + admission_source + specialty_group + age_group + diag_1_group + time_in_hospital + HbA1c_group + discharge_home:race + discharge_home:specialty_group + discharge_home:diag_1_group + discharge_home:time_in_hospital + specialty_group:time_in_hospital + specialty_group:age_group + diag_1_group:time_in_hospital + diag_1_group:HbA1c_group + (1|patient_nbr)
notes: Diabetes 130-US hospitals (Strack et al. 2014): 101766 encounters, patient_nbr repeats (up to 40 encounters per patient) so it is a genuine within-patient cluster. readmitted (NO/<30/>30) the documented target. Strack et al. de-duplicate to one encounter per patient and fit logistic regression (not mixed), so confidence low. encounter_id ignored; Hand sample #13 (O/low blind re-read): covariates and interactions are the final model of Strack et al. 2014 (sections 2.3-3, Tables 4-5): readmission within 30 days on the first encounter per patient, logistic, no random effects, so the patient intercept stays proposed. Recodes in the formula: discharge_home from discharge_disposition_id (home or other), admission_source from admission_source_id (emergency, referral, other), specialty_group from medical_specialty, age_group from age ([0,30), [30,60), [60,100)), diag_1_group the ICD-9 groups of diag_1, HbA1c_group from A1Cresult and change (no test, normal, high and changed, high and unchanged). RULE GAP: derived interaction; diag_1_group:HbA1c_group is in the formula only, diag_1:A1Cresult not being its encoding.

formula: WhiteClover-94 ~ strata + plot + WhiteClover-91 + WhiteClover-92 + WhiteClover-93 + BareGround-91 + BareGround-92 + BareGround-93 + BareGround-94 + Cocksfoot-91 + Cocksfoot-92 + Cocksfoot-93 + Cocksfoot-94 + OtherGrasses-91 + OtherGrasses-92 + OtherGrasses-93 + OtherGrasses-94 + OtherLegumes-91 + OtherLegumes-92 + OtherLegumes-93 + OtherLegumes-94 + RyeGrass-91 + RyeGrass-92 + RyeGrass-93 + RyeGrass-94 + Weeds-91 + Weeds-92 + Weeds-93 + Weeds-94 + (1|paddock)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: OpenML/WEKA white-clover persistence trial; documented ML target WhiteClover-94 binned into 4 ordered ranges. paddock (3, repeated) the clustering unit. RULE GAP: table is wide across 1991-1994 (species measures as year columns) and design columns strata/plot/paddock are ambiguously labelled; strata is used by the task as a predictor so filed as covariate. No published mixed model. Hand sample #13 (O/low blind re-read): plot (the three cultivars huia, prop, tahora) and the six other cover measures of 1991-94 added as covariates: the documented objective predicts 1994 white-clover cover from the other cover measures, the 1994 ones included (OpenML description; Thomson & McQueen's Waikato report, section 15). No published mixed model.
